// EXPECT OK
// Basic float arithmetic and literals

int main(void) {
    float x = 3.14;
    float y = 2.5;
    float z = x + y;
    float w = x * y;
    float v = x - y;
    float u = x / y;
    return 0;
}

        MOVE R2, R0             ; save original LO
        SHL R2, %D 16, R2       ; LO <<= 16
        SHR R0, %D 16, R0       ; extract upper 16 bits from original LO
        SHL R3, %D 16, R3       ; HI <<= 16
        OR R3, R0, R3           ; HI |= carry_from_LO
        CALL F_DIV64            ; 64-bit division: (|a| << 16) / |b|
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L14               ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L15              ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L16                  ; sign > 0 → no change
L14                             ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        JP L16
L15                             ; negate result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
L16                             ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value in R6
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

; Helper functions for multiplication and division

F_MUL                           ; Helper function: int mul(int a, int b)
; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L17               ; if b == 0, return 0
L18                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L19              ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L19                             ; skip negate a
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L20              ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L20                             ; skip negate b
; Binary shift-and-add multiplication (Russian peasant algorithm)
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign flag on stack
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L21                             ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L22               ; if b == 0, exit loop
        AND R1, %D 1, R3        ; R3 = b & 1
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_EQ L23               ; if (b & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L23                             ; skip add
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; a <<= 1
        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L21                  ; continue loop
L22                             ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L24               ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L24                  ; result ready
L17                             ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L24                             ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_MUL64                         ; Helper function: 64-bit unsigned multiplication
; F_MUL64: 64-bit unsigned integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) (both assumed non-negative)
; Output: R1 = high 32 bits, R0 = low 32 bits, R6 = copy of R0
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (int32, unsigned)
        LOAD R2, (R5+0C)        ; b (int32, unsigned)
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_NE L25               ; if b != 0, continue
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; HI = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; low 32 bits copy
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller
L25                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; M_HI = 0 (high 32 bits of multiplicand)
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; ACC_LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; ACC_HI = 0
L26                             ; 64-bit multiplication loop
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_EQ L29               ; if B == 0, exit loop
        AND R2, %D 1, R6        ; R6 = B & 1
        CMP R6, %D 0
        JR_EQ L27               ; if (B & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R3, R0, R6          ; R6 = ACC_LO + M_LO
        CMP R6, R3
        JR_SGE L28              ; if no carry, skip increment
        ADD R4, %D 1, R4        ; ACC_HI += 1
L28                             ; no carry
        MOVE R6, R3             ; ACC_LO = temp_lo
        ADD R4, R1, R4          ; ACC_HI = ACC_HI + M_HI
L27                             ; skip add
        MOVE R0, R6             ; save old M_LO
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; M_LO <<= 1
        SHR R6, %D 31, R6       ; R6 = (old M_LO >> 31) & 1 (carry bit)
        SHL R1, %D 1, R1        ; M_HI <<= 1
        OR R1, R6, R1           ; M_HI |= carry_from_LO
        SHR R2, %D 1, R2        ; B >>= 1
        JR L26                  ; continue loop
L29                             ; multiplication done
        MOVE R3, R0             ; LO → R0
        MOVE R4, R1             ; HI → R1
        MOVE R0, R6             ; low 32 bits copy for compatibility
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_DIV64                         ; Helper function: 64-bit unsigned division
; F_DIV64: 64-bit unsigned dividend / 32-bit unsigned divisor
; Input:  Dividend HI:LO in R3:R2 (64-bit unsigned)
;         Divisor in R1 (32-bit unsigned, > 0)
; Output: R0 = quotient (32-bit unsigned), R6 = copy of R0
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L30               ; division by zero
L31                             ; continue division
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; q = 0 (quotient)
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; remainder_HI = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; remainder_LO = 0
        SUB R7, %D 4, R7        ; allocate space for loop counter
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        STORE R0, (R5-04)       ; i = 0 (loop counter on stack)
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; q = 0 (restore quotient)
L32                             ; binary division loop (i = 0 to 63)
        LOAD R0, (R5-04)        ; load i from stack
        CMP R0, %D 64
        JR_SGE L33              ; if i >= 64, done
        PUSH R0                 ; save quotient on stack
        MOVE R6, R0             ; save old remainder_LO to R0 (temp)
        SHL R6, %D 1, R6        ; remainder_LO <<= 1
        SHR R0, %D 31, R0       ; carry bit from remainder_LO
        SHL R4, %D 1, R4        ; remainder_HI <<= 1
        OR R4, R0, R4           ; remainder_HI |= carry
        PUSH R3                 ; save dividend_HI on stack
        MOVE R3, R0             ; temp = dividend_HI (overwrite carry in R0)
        SHR R0, %D 31, R0       ; temp = (dividend_HI >> 31) & 1 (MSB)
        OR R6, R0, R6           ; remainder_LO |= MSB_from_dividend
        POP R3                  ; restore dividend_HI from stack
        MOVE R2, R0             ; save old dividend_LO to R0 (temp, overwrite MSB)
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; dividend_LO <<= 1
        SHR R0, %D 31, R0       ; carry bit from dividend_LO
        SHL R3, %D 1, R3        ; dividend_HI <<= 1
        OR R3, R0, R3           ; dividend_HI |= carry
        POP R0                  ; restore quotient from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_SGT L35              ; if remainder_HI > 0, remainder >= divisor
        CMP R6, R1
        JR_SLT L34              ; if remainder_LO < divisor, skip subtraction
L35                             ; do subtraction
        CMP R6, R1
        JR_SGE L36              ; if remainder_LO >= divisor, no borrow needed
        SUB R4, %D 1, R4        ; remainder_HI -= 1 (borrow)
L36                             ; no borrow
        SUB R6, R1, R6          ; remainder_LO -= divisor
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; q <<= 1
        OR R0, %D 1, R0         ; q |= 1
        JP L37                  ; skip quotient shift for skip case
L34                             ; skip subtraction
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; q <<= 1
L37                             ; after quotient update
        PUSH R0                 ; save quotient on stack before loading i
        LOAD R0, (R5-04)        ; load i from stack
        ADD R0, %D 1, R0        ; i++
        STORE R0, (R5-04)       ; store i back to stack
        POP R0                  ; restore quotient from stack
        JR L32                  ; continue loop
L33                             ; division done
        MOVE R0, R6             ; copy quotient to R6 for compatibility
        ADD R7, %D 4, R7        ; deallocate loop counter
        JP L38
L30                             ; division by zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; quotient = 0
        MOVE R0, R6             ; copy to R6
        ADD R7, %D 4, R7        ; deallocate stack space
L38                             ; end division
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

; Global variables

; Float helper functions (IEEE-754 single-precision)

F_FADD                          ; Helper function: float add(float a, float b)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, Q16.16)
        ADD R0, R1, R0          ; add Q16.16 values
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_FMUL                          ; Helper function: float mul(float a, float b)
; F_FMUL: Q16.16 float multiplication with explicit sign handling
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) as signed Q16.16
; Output: R6 = signed Q16.16 result
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (Q16.16)
        MOVE %D 1, R4           ; sign = +1
        OR R0, R0, R2           ; copy a into R2 and set flags
        JR_Z L2                 ; a == 0 → nothing
        JR_N L3                 ; a < 0 → negate
        JP L2                   ; a > 0 → nothing
L3                              ; negate a
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L2                              ; a sign handled
        OR R1, R1, R2           ; copy b into R2 and set flags
        JR_Z L4                 ; b == 0 → nothing
        JR_N L5                 ; b < 0 → negate
        JP L4                   ; b > 0 → nothing
L5                              ; negate b
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R1, R1          ; R1 = -R1
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L4                              ; b sign handled
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign on stack
        PUSH R1                 ; push |b|
        PUSH R0                 ; push |a|
        CALL F_MUL64            ; unsigned 64-bit product
        ADD R7, %D 8, R7        ; clean up arguments
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L6                ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L7               ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L8                   ; sign > 0 → no change
L6                              ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        MOVE %D 0, R1
        JP L8
L7                              ; negate 64-bit result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, %D 1, R2        ; R2 = -1 (0xFFFFFFFF)
        XOR R0, R2, R0          ; LO = ~LO
        XOR R1, R2, R1          ; HI = ~HI
        ADD R0, %D 1, R0        ; LO += 1
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_NE L9                ; if low != 0, no carry
        ADD R1, %D 1, R1        ; carry to high if low wrapped
L9                              ; negation done
L8                              ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R2             ; LO
        MOVE R1, R3             ; HI
        SHR R2, %D 16, R2       ; LO >> 16
        SHL R3, %D 16, R3       ; HI << 16
        OR R2, R3, R6           ; R6 = (LO >> 16) | (HI << 16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_I2F                           ; Helper function: float intToFloat(int value)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; integer value
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; multiply by 65536 to get Q16.16
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

; Helper functions for multiplication and division

F_MUL                           ; Helper function: int mul(int a, int b)
; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L10               ; if b == 0, return 0
L11                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L12              ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L12                             ; skip negate a
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L13              ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L13                             ; skip negate b
; Binary shift-and-add multiplication (Russian peasant algorithm)
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign flag on stack
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L14                             ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L15               ; if b == 0, exit loop
        AND R1, %D 1, R3        ; R3 = b & 1
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_EQ L16               ; if (b & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L16                             ; skip add
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; a <<= 1
        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L14                  ; continue loop
L15                             ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L17               ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L17                  ; result ready
L10                             ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L17                             ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_MUL64                         ; Helper function: 64-bit unsigned multiplication
; F_MUL64: 64-bit unsigned integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) (both assumed non-negative)
; Output: R1 = high 32 bits, R0 = low 32 bits, R6 = copy of R0
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (int32, unsigned)
        LOAD R2, (R5+0C)        ; b (int32, unsigned)
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_NE L18               ; if b != 0, continue
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; HI = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; low 32 bits copy
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller
L18                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; M_HI = 0 (high 32 bits of multiplicand)
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; ACC_LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; ACC_HI = 0
L19                             ; 64-bit multiplication loop
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_EQ L22               ; if B == 0, exit loop
        AND R2, %D 1, R6        ; R6 = B & 1
        CMP R6, %D 0
        JR_EQ L20               ; if (B & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R3, R0, R6          ; R6 = ACC_LO + M_LO
        CMP R6, R3
        JR_SGE L21              ; if no carry, skip increment
        ADD R4, %D 1, R4        ; ACC_HI += 1
L21                             ; no carry
        MOVE R6, R3             ; ACC_LO = temp_lo
        ADD R4, R1, R4          ; ACC_HI = ACC_HI + M_HI
L20                             ; skip add
        MOVE R0, R6             ; save old M_LO
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; M_LO <<= 1
        SHR R6, %D 31, R6       ; R6 = (old M_LO >> 31) & 1 (carry bit)
        SHL R1, %D 1, R1        ; M_HI <<= 1
        OR R1, R6, R1           ; M_HI |= carry_from_LO
        SHR R2, %D 1, R2        ; B >>= 1
        JR L19                  ; continue loop
L22                             ; multiplication done
        MOVE R3, R0             ; LO → R0
        MOVE R4, R1             ; HI → R1
        MOVE R0, R6             ; low 32 bits copy for compatibility
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

// EXPECT OK
// Nested structs with arrays and pointers

struct Inner {
    int value;
};

struct Outer {
    struct Inner inner;
    int arr[5];
    int *ptr;
};

int main(void) {
    struct Outer o;
    int x = 5;
    o.inner.value = 42;
    o.arr[0] = 1;
    o.ptr = &x;
    return 0;
}

; Float helper functions (IEEE-754 single-precision)

F_I2F                           ; Helper function: float intToFloat(int value)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; integer value
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; multiply by 65536 to get Q16.16
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_F2I                           ; Helper function: int floatToInt(float value)

        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; float value (Q16.16)
        SHR R0, %D 16, R0       ; divide by 65536 to get integer part

        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer

// EXPECT OK
// Complex example mixing all features

struct Point {
    float x;
    float y;
};

float distance(struct Point *p1, struct Point *p2) {
    float dx = (*p1).x - (*p2).x;
    float dy = (*p1).y - (*p2).y;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

int main(void) {
    struct Point p1;
    struct Point p2;
    float dist;
    int arr[10];
    int *p = arr;
    int i;
    int count = 10;
    
    p1.x = 1.0;
    p1.y = 2.0;
    p2.x = 3.0;
    p2.y = 4.0;
    
    dist = distance(&p1, &p2);
    
    for (i = 0; i < count; i = i + 1) {
        arr[i] = (int)dist + i;
        if (arr[i] > 100) {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
